nodes.description: Public mapping tracking token balances; mutated with unchecked += / -= in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount; written in approve and decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom and read by condition().
Whitelist mapping that lets an address bypass the ensure() sale restrictions.
Minimum sale amount set in init(); read by condition().
Maximum sale amount set in init(); read by condition().
Maximum number of sale transactions per address checked in condition().
Privileged address set by owner via setTradeAddress and used as whitelist bypass in ensure().
Privileged owner address assigned in the constructor and used for access control on admin functions.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Token name set at construction.
Token symbol set at construction.
Constant decimals value (18) used for scaling supply and sale limits.
Hardcoded Uniswap router constant address used in the ensure() whitelist check.
Public payable transfer that delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist gate: allows owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transferFrom that checks allowance, calls ensure(), and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] for caller-controlled inputs.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer storing sale parameters with unchecked scaling multiplication.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length and debits/credits balances without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Payable constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender and grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance and balance accounting.
Low-level delegatecall to an attacker-controllable address with arbitrary calldata, executed in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value (no SafeMath).
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value (no SafeMath).
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value (no SafeMath).
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length allowing overflow.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**decimals) / maxToken*(10**decimals) in init().

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument into transfer().
transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_to parameter flows into transfer().
_value parameter flows into transfer().
Recipient _to is forwarded from transfer() to transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value).
_from parameter is used in the ensure() whitelist checks.
_value parameter is used in ensure()/condition().
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the Uniswap pair address.
ensure() reads owner for the whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] for the whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads tradeAddress for the whitelist bypass.
ensure() compares _from against the hardcoded UNI router address to bypass sale restrictions.
condition() reads _minSale to bound the transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the transfer amount.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] as the authorization check.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender to index the allowance mapping for the spender check.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom() performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall(a, b) in the contract's storage context.
delegate() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner).
Target address a is supplied by the caller into the delegatecall target.
Calldata b is supplied by the caller into the delegatecall payload.
init() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner).
init() multiplies token/maxToken by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
saleNum parameter is written to _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale.
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
batchSend() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner) and debits msg.sender's balance.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend() mutates balanceOf with unchecked subtraction and additions.
_tos array drives the batchSend() loop.
_value is credited to each recipient in batchSend().
The unchecked multiplication result is stored in local total.
Loop index i controls iteration in batchSend().
setTradeAddress() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress.
approve() writes allowance with msg.sender as the owner key.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_spender parameter is used as the allowance key.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance amount.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the entire supply.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router address.
Constructor sets the token name.
Constructor sets the token symbol.
pairFor() returns the computed pair address consumed by the ensure() whitelist comparison.
